question: What is India's Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Index score as per the SDG Index released in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**67**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India's overall composite score in the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) India Index** released in **June 2025** is **67**.
 
• With a score of **67**, India continues to be classified in the **Front Runner** category, which includes entities with scores ranging from **65 to 99**.
 
• The **SDG India Index** is the country's principal tool for measuring progress toward the **United Nations' 2030 Agenda**, and it is meticulously compiled and released by **NITI Aayog**.
 
• The **2024-25** assessment shows a significant upward trend compared to the **2020-21** score of **66** and the **2019** score of **60**, indicating steady national progress across various socio-economic and environmental dimensions.
 
• The improvement in the national score is primarily driven by exemplary performance in **Goal 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy)**, **Goal 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production)**, and **Goal 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation)**.
